# Open Telestrator

> Free, open-source sports telestrator and live commentary studio that runs entirely in a web browser. Draw over any sport as it happens, commentate, and send viewers one link — no account, no capture card and no cost.

Open Telestrator is a static web app (React, WebRTC and PeerJS) hosted on GitHub Pages. The host shares a browser tab or a camera as the video source, draws over it with arrows, circles and freehand strokes, records instant replays, mixes commentary audio, and broadcasts the program to viewers peer-to-peer. Viewers — and phones acting as extra camera angles — join by opening a link or scanning a QR code, and the player can be embedded in another site with a plain iframe.

- Home page: https://spuds0588.github.io/open-telestrator/
- Studio app: https://spuds0588.github.io/open-telestrator/app.html
- Source code and MIT licence: https://github.com/Spuds0588/open-telestrator

## Key facts

- Cost: free and open source (MIT); no account, subscription or paid tier.
- Equipment: any webcam, phone camera or browser tab; no capture card or mixer needed.
- Sports: any — the video source is whatever plays in a browser tab or comes from a camera.
- Broadcast: live-only, peer-to-peer over WebRTC. Viewers form a relay tree, so the stream never passes through a server and the host's uplink stays small.
- Viewing: any modern browser, phone or desktop, with play/pause, volume, full screen and picture-in-picture; share by link or embed in an iframe.
- Studio entries: the landing page lives at `/`; the host studio, `?watch=` viewer and `?camera=` cameraman entries live at `/app.html`.
